timeBasis: T0 from preflight; game events have 1 second resolution. Source line numbers refer to local private snapshots, not public full logs.
omissions: Block handoffs summarized by resource and common lease, with block IDs and ranges of per-block timing/source lines. Intermediate download_progress omitted; completed files, pause/resume and lifecycle retained. Repeated HTTP 503 summarized with first/last boundaries in E-011. Duplicate game callbacks lacking song IDs omitted. E-006 selects first blocks and slow-seek block 43; complete traces retained in the locally prepared, unpublished sanitized archive. E-008 includes every started block for the two resume assertions.
